compress_text_zlib: create a TextCompressor with low level and compress a string using zlib compression
compress_text_unishox2: create a TextCompressor with high level and compress a string using unishox2 compression
decompress_text_zlib: create a TextCompressor with low level and decompress zlib compressed bytes back to a string
decompress_text_unishox2: create a TextCompressor with high level and decompress unishox2 compressed bytes back to a string
compress_text_noop: create a TextCompressor with none level and encode a string without any compression
